acceptanceCriteria: With the setting absent, behaviour is unchanged.
Three short sessions hold the next launch; one longer session resets the streak.
The hold appears in `dispatch status` and the event log with its reason.
The finding names the ticket, count, median duration and first-seen time.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1038 (opened 2026-10-17). Feature request; not yet specified. Problem A ticket can be relaunched over and over by sessions that each end within minutes, recording a little progress or exiting cleanly. Each pays the full start-up cost for little work. Backoff applies only after runs without progress, so churn that counts as progress is never throttled. Current workaround A work-state script holds a ticket for 60 minutes when its last 3 sessions each ended in under 20 minutes. A doctor script flags 3 or more sessions under 4 minutes within 30 minutes, and 6 or more launches in 2 hours with a median under 10 minutes. Proposal Role or global `shortSessions {seconds, count, holdSeconds}`: after `count` consecutive finished sessions of one ticket shorter than `seconds`, new launches for it wait `holdSeconds` from the last end. Running sessions are never touched. Emit an event, show it in `dispatch status`, and add a doctor finding SESSION_CHURN. See beamfall/corvint#1038 for the full text.
title: dispatch: cooldown and doctor finding for repeated short sessions on one ticket (issue #1038)
